name: implementation-and-integration
description: Implement approved frontend, backend, API, data, and component work using repository-first reuse and bounded subagents.

# Implementation and integration

Follow the actual stack. Reuse in order: existing component, design system, Storybook, project registry, shadcn-compatible registry, then custom code. Consume UX/architecture artifacts without casual redesign. Use migrations, TDD, accessibility/security/performance work only when the task requires them.

For delegation, give goal, context, allowed scope, exclusions, dependencies, acceptance, required checks, and handoff. Parent owns sequencing, integration, and final verification.
